|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Lone Pilot (V)]]; it is the current text. The images here are the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-42-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-lonepilot-pre.gif]]), which print this text.
* '''Original''' ([[Lone Pilot (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet, first copy (official text as of 4 September 2009; slip [[:File:VB6-45-Lone_Pilot-original-sheet.png]])<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Black Leader, Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, or Guri (may also ▲ a system with 1 [Dark Side Force], a matching starship, and an always [Immune to Alter] Effect.) When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lone Pilot (V) (Errata)]]): the revised copy of the sheet (PDF dated 20 April 2010; slip [[:File:VB6-45-Lone_Pilot.png]])<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 6, slip 45. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> changed “with 1” to “with exactly 1”: “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Black Leader, Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, or Guri (may also ▲ a system with exactly 1 [Dark Side Force], a matching starship, and an always [Immune to Alter] Effect.) When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lone Pilot (V) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) lists “a matching starship” before “a system with exactly 1 [Dark Side Force]” and closes “Effect).”: “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Black Leader, Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, or Guri (may also ▲ a matching starship, a system with exactly 1 [Dark Side Force], and an always [Immune to Alter] Effect). When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”<ref name="cl-1261_42-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the ▲ icons out as “Take into hand from Reserve Deck” and runs “Force.STARTING” together; the icons are shown here as on the slips. No published card image prints this text; the image on [[Lone Pilot (V) (Errata 2)]] is a CardMaker recreation.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Black Leader becomes Juno Eclipse and the original order returns: “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, Guri, or Juno Eclipse (may also ▲ a system with exactly 1 [Dark Side Force], a matching starship, and an always [Immune to Alter] Effect.) When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” Printed in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) (slip [[:File:VL-history-1261-42-front-master.png]])<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=37, page 37. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=37 Internet Archive]</ref>; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-lonepilot-pre.gif]]) prints the same text.
